Beginner Guide: How This Call Trade Works in Plain Dollars

Why LEAPS instead of a short-dated call: With 305 days until 2027-09-17 and 0.69 delta, this option behaves ~68% like owning 100 shares for a fraction of the cash, while losing only $8.50/day to time decay.

Worst-case wallet risk: You pay $49.25 x 100 shares x 1 = $4,925.00 upfront. Even if CB crashed 50% overnight, you cannot lose more than $4,925.00.

Volatility check: Implied Volatility is 21.6% vs. 20-day actual stock volatility of 20.3% (IV FAIR), so you are not overpaying panic premiums.
